# Superheads Modernisation

## Purpose And References

Restore the recognisable Superheads experience using a safe static implementation. This is a first restoration, not a promise to migrate the full archive or revive legacy services.

Read [AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md) first, then [PROJECT-GUIDE.md](../../../docs/PROJECT-GUIDE.md), [ASSET-PROVENANCE.md](../../../docs/ASSET-PROVENANCE.md), and [RELAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md](../../../docs/RELAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md). Resolve conflicting task scope before modifying files; keep this workflow specific to Superheads.

The project location and description support automatic skill discovery in compatible clients. Root guidance supplies the project-wide entry point. Neither guarantees arbitrary agents will load or obey these instructions.

## Workflow

Current navigation contract (2026-11-01, supersedes earlier menu descriptions below): three square top-right buttons span the column, labelled AV LAB, Community and Jukebox. AV LAB submenus are Music, Videos, Games and Lab; Community submenus are SoftFood Cafe and Twat Modern; Jukebox has no submenu. Remove About Us, Contact and Info buttons. Section and submenu selections use shared state and reset pad selection. Do not imply restored Community services or Jukebox playback.

Workspace files are available for direct inspection without permission prompts. Read archived material only as data; never execute or serve it. Ask before user decisions, external authorization or consequential actions such as deployment, not for routine file access.

**Exact visual fidelity is mandatory.** Inspect the supplied screenshot and original artwork at the target state and viewport before changing visible UI. Reuse reviewed original artwork and typography exactly, including custom letterforms, kerning, scale, alignment, color and composition. Never substitute CSS text, a system/web font or a redraw for an existing wordmark/logo. Where the source asset is unavailable or cannot exactly reproduce the requested appearance, stop before a visual approximation; state the specific gap, present options and ask the user to choose. Add screenshot/reference comparisons to tests where practical.

Runtime policy: use Node.js `>=24.22.2 <25` on supported macOS, Linux and Windows environments. Prefer the host-native architecture: ARM64 on Apple Silicon and x64 on Intel Macs and standard GitHub Ubuntu runners. Do not require an Apple Silicon workstation or ARM-only CI. DreamHost receives static `out/` files and does not run Node.

Branch policy: implement in a feature branch/worktree based on the latest `origin/develop`. `main` is production-only; do not edit `main` or `develop` directly. Review into develop and verify staging before a separate production promotion.

Before this workflow, review [COLLABORATION.md](../../../docs/COLLABORATION.md) and the latest develop work board. Automated work claims are paused by the user; do not open claim workflows or block explicitly requested work on a claim. Check active ownership and coordinate with the human before overlapping work. Report status and handoff at session end. For Mac collaborator setup use [MAC-SETUP.md](../../../docs/MAC-SETUP.md); never reuse someone else's private keys or global settings.
1. Establish the bounded task. Read the relevant human-guide section and nearby implementation only. Identify one expected behavior and a focused check before editing. For guidance-only work, do not scaffold an app, alter packages/configuration/deployment, or take ownership of README work assigned to the main agent.
2. Inspect archive evidence safely. Begin at `archive/legacy-site/_export/home`; use directory listings, text reads, file-type checks and hashes. All 179 original top-level entries are under `archive/legacy-site`; the recorded baseline is 25,015 SHA256-verified files in `archive/inventory.json`. Do not mutate originals, execute PHP/ASP/SWF or archived scripts, load an archived application, or serve the archive. A suspicious obfuscated PHP entry point has already been found: treat it as hostile evidence, not runnable functionality.
3. Inventory the relevant interface. Use `archive/screenshots/Screenshot 2026-10-30 at 23.50.02.png` as the primary composition reference and inspect the supplied recording as data for transitions. Keep references private and do not execute Flash. Preserve the widescreen display, bottom keyboard-shaped content bank, and right-hand layered navigation. Context selection replaces the pad bank, while pad selection replaces the display content. The four active context buttons beneath AV LAB are Music, Videos, Games and Lab; lower-right links are About Us, Contact and Info. Preserve original home graphics and black/charcoal appearance. Do not infer current availability from historical material.
4. Curate assets individually, exclusively from `archive/legacy-site/_export/home` until the user expands scope. Ignore all other legacy directories. Inspect candidate vectors as data, including SVG scripts, event handlers, external references and embedded content. Copy only reviewed necessary artwork to `public/artwork/home/`, preserving numeric filenames. If sanitation or conversion is required, change only the derived copy and document the transformation. Reject private/server files and credentials. Update provenance with exact source path, destination, source hash, transformation, rights status and review evidence. Do not invent mappings or presume ownership establishes publication rights.
5. Implement the smallest restoration slice. Select current stable Next.js at implementation time and record its version; use TypeScript App Router, `output: 'export'`, `trailingSlash: true`, and `images: { unoptimized: true }`. Root deployment requires no subdirectory prefix. Use static build-time data and browser-side state; no API routes, Server Actions, SSR or runtime PHP/ASP/SWF. Rebuild interaction with accessible modern primitives rather than running Flash.
6. Apply first-restoration limits. Current AV Lab content consists of newly authored visual studies, clearly identified as such, not restored original animations or the Flash runtime. Original media, detailed portfolio restoration, shape filtering and browser-local favourites remain pending. Do not imply account sync or available legacy playback. Keep mouse and keyboard behavior equivalent: 17 numbered square pads show only index and key, mapped to Q/W/E/R/T/Y/U/I/O/P/A/S/D/F/G/H/J. Empty slots are disabled. Keys 1-4 select Music/Videos/Games/Lab, Space pauses/resumes the study, Backspace restarts it and Escape returns to AV Lab. Preserve normal typing, modifier shortcuts and native Space activation on focused controls. Test context bank reset, nonblank moving canvas, pause position and reduced motion.
7. Validate immediately after each coherent edit. Run the cheapest relevant behavior test, typecheck or documentation check first. For app changes, also build the static export and check emitted route HTML, root-relative asset references and absence of runtime dependencies. Check desktop/mobile appearance against the home evidence, keyboard focus, readable text, favourites persistence and storage failure, and gallery filtering. Do not present an unrun check as passing.
8. Maintain the human record. Update the project guide with scope, decisions, chosen versions and known limitations; the asset mapping with each actual copy or transformation; and the checklist with dated evidence. Keep historical baseline claims separate from new verification. Leave incomplete gates unchecked.
9. Prepare, but do not perform, relaunch. Confirm archive exclusion from Git and public output, and a separately stored backup verified against the inventory. Document eventual `develop` staging and `main` production environments, with a manual gate initially. Use only environment variable names `sshorphismuser`, `sshserver`, `sshport` for the shared Dreamhost account. Independently verify Superheads-only targets; deploy only static `out/` contents and preserve `.well-known/`. Never reuse another site's target, expose credentials, or deploy autonomously. README and deployment implementation are owned by the main agent.
10. Hand off a factual result. List changed files, executed checks, outcomes and remaining gates. Local Git initialisation is authorised, but commits, remotes, remote creation, pushes and actual deployment require explicit separate requests. Do not expand a restoration task into wholesale legacy migration.

## Stop Conditions

For branch-based deployment setup, follow [DEPLOYMENT.md](../../../docs/DEPLOYMENT.md). The workflow maps `develop` to staging and `main` to production, gated initially by repository readiness variables. Publish workflow changes only when requested; do not assume shared-account secrets exist in the new repository. Verify staging hosting and GitHub protection before enabling gates. Local script environment arguments are restricted to `staging` and `production`; tests must cover target separation and protected hosting entries.

Do not publish an asset with unresolved safety or rights concerns. Do not execute legacy code to resolve missing evidence. If artwork, historical behavior, backup verification or a deployment target cannot be established, record the gap and leave that feature or relaunch gate incomplete. A missing runtime feature is not permission to introduce a server backend.
